verified_contracts: Missing password and wrong password preserve incomplete report and occurrence identity
RC4-40, AES-128, AES-256 R5/R6; empty user password and supplied owner password
AES ZIP and nested AES PDF use different supplied passwords
Original encrypted bytes remain unchanged; plaintext child has its own size, hash and provenance
Native ClamAV/YARA and applicable stages rescan decrypted child
Inert JavaScript and Launch actions survive decryption without execution
Unreferenced active-xref stream survives and its synthetic xmrig marker produces child-scoped YARA evidence
Persistent checkpoint recovers after disposable local cache deletion; completed stages are unchanged
Completed resume does not duplicate decrypted occurrences
Private output, high-water cumulative budgets, depth/input/output/object-count limits, timeout and cancellation cleanup
Missing or failed child submission keeps partial; available outer detections survive password exhaustion
Public report, durable checkpoint and parser logs do not contain fixture passwords
remaining_limits: Historical superseded PDF revisions and arbitrary trailing bytes are not decrypted
Rewritten child does not preserve the original digital signature validity or every special PDF feature
Differentiated EFF, explicit Crypt streams and EncryptMetadata=false remain unsupported
Office password decryption and PDF attachment extraction remain separate work
Synthetic acceptance is not a real-world detection-rate estimate
Native local tests and existing cloud reports do not verify this new feature on production providers
